PFPI

CRITTERS RIDE 2 COONSKINS TO PFPI WEEK 6 CROWN;  3 TEAMS NOW WITHIN 1 GAME OF ROUGHRIDERS’ LEAD

Chris’ Critters were workin’ 9-5 to win PFPI Week 6 honors, while three teams are now bunched in a tie for second place, 1 game behind Dick’s Roughriders.

The Critters scored two Unique Hits, cashing Coonskins for Titans over Colts and Saints over Giants. Christie’s Ferraris went solo  on  Broncos over Seahawks.

PFPI’s 23rd season makes its turn past the one-third mark – now six weeks down and 12 to go in the long climb to the Dad’s Dynamics Championship Trophy.
